questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bold/underlined word in the sentence.

His refusal to __**comply**__ with the pope's injunctions led to a renewal of the war.
questions.solution: The correct answer is '**obey**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • ​​​The word ‘**comply**’(verb) means- "to obey an order or request". (आदेश या अनुरोध को मानना) • *E.g: There are serious penalties for failure to **comply **with the regulations.* • *​*Let’s have a look at the meaning of the words that are given in the options: • ​**ignore**(verb)- “to pay no attention to somebody/something”. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु पर कोई ध्यान न देना, की उपेक्षा करना) • **amass**(verb)- “to collect or put together a large quantity of something”. (किसी वस्‍तु को बड़ी मात्रा में एकत्रित या संचित कर देना) • **obey**(verb)- “to do what you are told to do”. (आज्ञा का पालन करना) • **berate**(verb)- “to criticize or speak in an angry manner to someone”. (किसी से क्रोधित तरीके से आलोचना करना या बोलना) • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that ‘obey’ is the correct synonym of the given bold word. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • The synonyms of the given word 'comply' are- 'obey', '**observe**', 'adhere', '**accord**', '**respect**', etc. • The antonyms of the given word 'comply' are- '**disobey**', '**neglect**', 'ignore', '**reject**', etc. • Example of 'comply' in a sentence__: • *He was jailed for refusing to **comply **with the court order.* 37:Tf81, The correct answer is 'Besieged'.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bold word in the sentence.

They were **contemplating** a move to California.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- **'Observe'**

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• let's look at the meaning of the given word and the correct answer.
 
• Contemplating​: to spend time considering a possible future action, or to consider one particular thing for a long time in a serious and quiet way (संभावित भविष्य की कार्रवाई पर विचार करने के लिए समय बिताने के लिए, या एक विशेष बात पर लंबे समय तक गंभीर और शांत तरीके से विचार करने के लिए)
 
 
• ​Example: It's too awful/horrific/dangerous to **contemplate.**
 
 
 
• Observe: to watch carefully the way something happens or the way someone does something, especially in order to learn more about it (ध्यान से देखने के लिए कि कुछ कैसे होता है या जिस तरह से कोई कुछ करता है, विशेष रूप से इसके बारे में अधिक जानने के लिए) 
 
 
• Example: The role of scientists is to **observe** and describe the world, not to try to control it.
 
 

Hence, the word Observe is the most appropriate synonym for Contemplating​. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

Let's explore the meaning of other options:

__
 
• **Forget****:** to be unable to remember a fact, something that happened, or how to do something (किसी तथ्य को याद रखने में असमर्थ होना, कुछ हुआ, या कुछ कैसे करना है)
 
• **Neglect****:** to not give enough care or attention to people or things that are your responsibility (लोगों या उन चीज़ों पर पर्याप्त ध्यान या ध्यान न देना जो आपकी ज़िम्मेदारी हैं)
 
• **Discard****:** to throw something away or get rid of it because you no longer want or need it (किसी चीज को फेंक देना या उससे छुटकारा पाना क्योंकि अब आपको इसकी आवश्यकता या आवश्यकता नहीं है)

questions.question:
**From the following pairs of words, select the one which is synonymous:**

A. Noxious - Munificent

B. Nebulous - Clear

C. Entice - Attract

D. Adversary - Friend
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **C**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the given words:-

 
 
• **Noxious **- harmful, poisonous, or very unpleasant.
 
• **Munificent **- characterized by or displaying great generosity.
 
• **Nebulous **- in the form of a cloud or haze; hazy.
 
• **Clear **- easy to perceive, understand or interpret.
 
 
• Thus, '**clear**' is the antonym of '**nebulous**'.
 
 
 
• **Entice **- attract or tempt by offering pleasure or advantage.
 
• **Attract **- cause (someone) to have a liking for or interest in something.
 
 
• Thus, '**entice**' is the synonym of '**attract**'.
 
 
 
• **Adversary **- one's opponent in a contest, conflict, or dispute.
 
• **Friend **- a person who is not an enemy or opponent; an ally.
 
 
• Thus, '**friend**' is an antonym of '**adversary**'.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the pair that is synonymous with each other is** 'Entice - Attract'.**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bold word in the sentence.

He __**chattered**__ happily about nothing in particular.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- **'Speak'**

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• let's look at the meaning of the given word and the correct answer.
 
• Chattered**:** to talk for a long time about things that are not important (उन चीजों के बारे में लंबे समय तक बात करना जो महत्वपूर्ण नहीं हैं)
 
 
• ​Example: She spent the morning **chattering** away to her friends.
 
 
 
• Speak: to say words, to use the voice, or to have a conversation with someone (शब्द कहने के लिए, आवाज का उपयोग करने के लिए, या किसी के साथ बातचीत करने के लिए) 
 
 
• Example: She **spoke **of her sadness over her father's death.
 
 

Hence, the word Speak is the most appropriate synonym for Chattered. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

Let's explore the meaning of other options:

 
• **Refrain****:** to avoid doing or stop yourself from doing something (कुछ करने से बचने या खुद को कुछ करने से रोकने के लिए)
 
• **Drawl****:** a slow way of speaking in which the vowel sounds are made longer and words are not separated clearly (बोलने का एक धीमा तरीका जिसमें स्वर ध्वनियाँ लंबी होती हैं और शब्द स्पष्ट रूप से अलग नहीं होते हैं)
 
• **Quiet****:** making very little noise (बहुत कम शोर करना)

questions.question:
Direction: Select the word that is most SIMILAR in the meaning of the bold word.

The judge had caused __**astonishment** __at the same court in April when he sentenced the 59-year-old.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is-** 'Amazement'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• let's look at the meaning of the given word and the correct answer.
 
• Astonishment (noun): very great surprise. (बहुत बड़ा आश्चर्य।)
 
 
• ​Example:* **To the astonishment of her colleagues, she resigned.**​*
 
 
 
• Amazement(verb): to cause someone to be extremely surprised. (किसी को अत्यधिक आश्चर्यचकित करना।)
 
 
• Example:* **I was **amazed **by how well he looked.*

 
 
 

Hence, the word Amazement is the most appropriate synonym for Astonishment. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 

 

 

 
• Let's explore the meaning of other options:
 
• **Ennui**(noun): a feeling of being bored and mentally tired caused by having nothing interesting or exciting to do. (कुछ भी दिलचस्प या रोमांचक न होने के कारण ऊब और मानसिक रूप से थके होने की भावना।)
 
 
• Example:* **The whole country seems to be affected by the **ennui **of winter.*
 
 
 
• **Tedium**(noun): the quality of being boring for a long time. (लंबे समय तक उबाऊ रहने का गुण।)
 
 
• Example:* Soldiers often say that the worst thing about fighting is not the moments of terror, but all the hours of **tedium **in between.*
 
 
 
• **Apathy**(noun): behaviour that shows no interest or energy and shows that someone is unwilling to take action, especially over something important. (व्यवहार जो कोई दिलचस्पी या ऊर्जा नहीं दिखाता है और दिखाता है कि कोई कार्रवाई करने को तैयार नहीं है, खासकर किसी महत्वपूर्ण चीज पर।)
 
 
• Example:* **widespread **apathy **among students.*

questions.question:
Direction: Match List I with List II (Synonyms)

List I List II

A. Amazing I. Dreadful

B. Anger II. Inquire

C. Ask​ III. Enrage

D. Awful IV. Incredible

Choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'A-IV, B-III, C-II, D-I​​.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let us see the **meanings **of the given options:

 
 
• **Amazing: **very surprising and difficult to believe; incredible. (आश्‍चर्यजनक और अविश्‍वसनीय; अतिविस्‍मयकारी)
 
• **Anger: **the strong feeling that you have when something has happened or somebody has done something that you do not like. (क्रोध, ग़ुस्‍सा, रोष)
 
• **Ask: **to put a question to somebody in order to find out some information. (जानकारी के लिए प्रश्‍न पूछना)
 
• **Awful: **very bad or unpleasant. (बहुत बुरा, अत्‍यधिक अरुचिकर)
 
• **Dreadful: **very bad or unpleasant. (बहुत घटिया या नीरस, अरुचिकर)
 
• **Inquire: **ask for information from someone. (किसी से जानकारी मांगना)
 
• **Enrage: **to make somebody very angry. ((किसी व्‍यक्ति को) बहुत ग़ुस्‍सा दिलाना, अत्‍यधिक क्रोधित कर देना)
 
• **Incredible: **impossible or very difficult to believe. (जिस पर विश्‍वास करना असंभव या बहुत कठिन हो; अविश्‍वसनीय)
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is Option 3.
 
• Correct match:
 
 
• **Amazing: Incredible**
 
• **Anger: Enrage**
 
• **Ask: Inquire**
 
• **Awful: Dreadful**

questions.question:
**From the following pairs of words, select the one which is synonymous:**

(A) Incredible - Believable

(B) Sorrow - Joy

(C) Hazardous - Dangerous

(D) Vacant - Occupied
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the words given as the correct answer:-

 
 
• **Hazardous **- risky; dangerous.
 
• **Dangerous **- able or likely to cause harm or injury.
 
 
 
• After looking at the meanings of the given words, it is clear that both the words are **synonyms **of each other.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the other words given in options:-

 
 
• **Incredible **- impossible to believe.
 
• **Believable **- seemingly possible or true; credible.
 
• **Sorrow **- a feeling of deep distress caused by loss, disappointment, or other misfortune suffered by oneself or others.
 
• **Joy **- a feeling of great pleasure and happiness.
 
• **Vacant **- (of a place) not occupied; empty.
 
• **Occupied **- (of a building, seat, etc.) being used by someone.
